# Fixture advisory with a malformed CVSS vector

A FIXTURE advisory (s8c §8c.4; D21-63), not a real one. It matches `itoa 1.0.18` in
`../advisory-db/project/Cargo.lock`. Its CVSS v3.1 vector lacks the base metric `A`, so the in-tree
scorer cannot score it and a scan that matches it refuses by name (`cvss-unscorable`).
